    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowFive" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowFive" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stockForPartBelow5}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotBelowFive" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowFive" targetRef="End_BuildingUnderway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Event_CheapBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Event_CheapBatch" targetRef="Task_UpdateAfterCheapBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_UpdateAfterCheapBatch" targetRef="Gateway_BelowThree"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowThree" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowThree" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stockForPartBelow3}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotBelowThree" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowThree" targetRef="Task_Build"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Event_FastBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Event_FastBatch" targetRef="Task_UpdateAfterFastBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="Task_UpdateAfterFastBatch" targetRef="Task_Build"/>

      <bpmn:text>Parts arrive in batches in random order; delivery is typically 2 days earlier or later than expected.</bpmn:text>

  </bpmn:process>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CheapReorder" name="Cheapest parts reorder" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FastReorder" name="Fastest parts reorder" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReorderBatch" name="Reordered parts batch" sourceRef="Event_ReorderBatch" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_PartsBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Complaint email" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Contract">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ProjectOwner" name="Contract project">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Contract</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreatePartsList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_QueryShop</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AllShopsQueried</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompareOffers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OneShopEnough</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ListOneShop</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ListSeveralShops</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeLists</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceInitialOrders</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_FirstBatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StartBuilding</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Build</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StockZero</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EmailFriends</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeZeroCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StockBelowFive</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StockBelowThree</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReorderCheapest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReorderFastest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeReorders</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_ReorderBatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateStock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ContinueBuilding</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Contract" name="Contract project starts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreatePartsList" name="Create list of required parts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_QueryShop" name="Query a web shop" messageRef="Message_ShopQuery"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer" name="Obtain quantity, price and delivery time" messageRef="Message_ShopOffer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllShopsQueried" name="Have all web shops been queried?" default="Flow_QueryAnotherShop"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompareOffers" name="Compare offers and identify the cheapest parts"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OneShopEnough" name="Can one shop supply enough parts?" default="Flow_NotEnoughFromOne"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ListOneShop" name="List parts to order from the cheapest suitable shop"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ListSeveralShops" name="List parts to order from several shops using the cheapest parts"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeLists" name="Merge order-list alternatives"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceInitialOrders" name="Place initial parts orders" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FirstBatch" name="First parts batch arrives">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FirstBatch" messageRef="Message_PartsBatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StartBuilding" name="Start building"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Build" name="Build using available parts"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockZero" name="Is stock for a single part zero?" default="Flow_StockNotZero"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmailFriends" name="Email friends complaining about the web shops" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeZeroCheck" name="Continue stock checks"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockBelowFive" name="Is stock for a single part below 5?" default="Flow_StockAtLeastFive"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockBelowThree" name="Is stock for that part below 3?" default="Flow_StockAtLeastThree"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder the cheapest parts" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder again from the fastest shop" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeReorders" name="Merge reorder alternatives"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReorderBatch" name="Reordered parts batch arrives">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReorderBatch" messageRef="Message_PartsBatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateStock" name="Update stock for received batch"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ContinueBuilding" name="Continue building with stock at least 5"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_Contract" targetRef="Task_CreatePartsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_CreatePartsList" targetRef="Task_QueryShop"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_QueryShop" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Gateway_AllShopsQueried"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllShopsQueried" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AllShopsQueried" targetRef="Task_CompareOffers">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allWebShopsQueried}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_QueryAnotherShop" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AllShopsQueried" targetRef="Task_QueryShop"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_CompareOffers" targetRef="Gateway_OneShopEnough"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OneShopEnough" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_OneShopEnough" targetRef="Task_ListOneShop">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${oneShopCanSupplyEnoughParts}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotEnoughFromOne" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_OneShopEnough" targetRef="Task_ListSeveralShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_ListOneShop" targetRef="Gateway_MergeLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_ListSeveralShops" targetRef="Gateway_MergeLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeLists" targetRef="Task_PlaceInitialOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_PlaceInitialOrders" targetRef="Event_FirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Event_FirstBatch" targetRef="Task_StartBuilding"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_StartBuilding" targetRef="Task_Build"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_Build" targetRef="Gateway_StockZero"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockZero" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_StockZero" targetRef="Task_EmailFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stockForPartIsZero}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockNotZero" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_StockZero" targetRef="Gateway_MergeZeroCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Gateway_MergeZeroCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeZeroCheck" targetRef="Gateway_StockBelowFive"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockBelowFive" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_StockBelowFive" targetRef="Gateway_StockBelowThree">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stockForPartBelow5}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockAtLeastFive" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_StockBelowFive" targetRef="End_ContinueBuilding"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockBelowThree" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_StockBelowThree" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stockForPartBelow3}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockAtLeastThree" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_StockBelowThree" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_MergeReorders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeReorders" targetRef="Event_ReorderBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Event_ReorderBatch" targetRef="Task_UpdateStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_UpdateStock" targetRef="Task_Build"/>

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_DeliveryTiming">
      <bpmn:text>Parts arrive in batches in random order, typically 2 days earlier or later than expected.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_FirstBatchTiming" sourceRef="Annotation_DeliveryTiming" targetRef="Event_FirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_ReorderBatchTiming" sourceRef="Annotation_DeliveryTiming" targetRef="Event_ReorderBatch"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Contract"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShopQuery" name="Shop query"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShopOffer" name="Available quantity, price and delivery time"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartsOrder" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartsBatch" name="Parts batch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FriendsComplaint" name="Complaint about web shops"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ContractProject" name="Contract project" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WebShops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShopQuery" name="Query a web shop" sourceRef="Task_QueryShop" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_ShopQuery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShopOffer" name="Shop offer" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" messageRef="Message_ShopOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialOrder" name="Initial parts orders" sourceRef="Task_PlaceInitialOrders" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstBatch" name="First parts batch" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_FirstBatch" messageRef="Message_PartsBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CheapestReorder" name="Cheapest parts reorder" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CheapestBatch" name="Reordered parts batch" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_CheapestBatch" messageRef="Message_PartsBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FastestReorder" name="Fastest parts reorder" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FastestBatch" name="Reordered parts batch" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_FastestBatch" messageRef="Message_PartsBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Email complaining about web shops" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_FriendsComplaint"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Contract">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ProjectOwner" name="Project owner">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Contract</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreatePartsList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeShopQueryCycles</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MoreShopsToQuery</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_QueryShop</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompareOffers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OneShopEnough</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ListPartsForOneShop</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ListPartsForSeveralShops</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeOrderLists</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceInitialOrders</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_FirstBatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StartBuilding</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Build</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StockZero</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EmailFriends</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StockBelowFive</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReorderCheapest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CheapestBatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateStockAfterCheapestBatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StockBelowThree</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReorderFastest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_FastestBatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateStockAfterFastestBatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ContinueBuilding</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Contract" name="Contract project starts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreatePartsList" name="Create list of required parts"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeShopQueryCycles" name="Continue shop-query cycle"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MoreShopsToQuery" name="Are there web shops left to query?" default="Flow_NoMoreShops"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_QueryShop" name="Query a web shop" messageRef="Message_ShopQuery"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer" name="Obtain available quantity, price and delivery time" messageRef="Message_ShopOffer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompareOffers" name="Compare offers and identify the cheapest parts"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OneShopEnough" name="Can one shop supply enough parts?" default="Flow_SeveralShops"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ListPartsForOneShop" name="List parts to order from one shop at the cheapest prices"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ListPartsForSeveralShops" name="List parts to order from several shops at the cheapest prices"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeOrderLists" name="Merge order-list alternatives"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceInitialOrders" name="Place initial parts orders" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FirstBatch" name="First parts batch arrives">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FirstBatch" messageRef="Message_PartsBatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StartBuilding" name="Start building"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Build" name="Build using available parts"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockZero" name="Is stock for a single part zero?" default="Flow_StockNotZero"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmailFriends" name="Email friends complaining about the web shops" messageRef="Message_FriendsComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockBelowFive" name="Is stock for a single part below 5?" default="Flow_StockNotBelowFive"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder the cheapest parts" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CheapestBatch" name="Reordered parts batch arrives">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CheapestBatch" messageRef="Message_PartsBatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateStockAfterCheapestBatch" name="Update stock for received batch"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockBelowThree" name="Is stock for a single part below 3?" default="Flow_StockNotBelowThree"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder the fastest parts" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FastestBatch" name="Fastest reorder batch arrives">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FastestBatch" messageRef="Message_PartsBatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateStockAfterFastestBatch" name="Update stock for received batch"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ContinueBuilding" name="Continue building"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToPartsList" sourceRef="Start_Contract" targetRef="Task_CreatePartsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsListToShopCycle" sourceRef="Task_CreatePartsList" targetRef="Gateway_MergeShopQueryCycles"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferToShopCycle" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Gateway_MergeShopQueryCycles"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShopCycleToDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeShopQueryCycles" targetRef="Gateway_MoreShopsToQuery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MoreShops" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreShopsToQuery" targetRef="Task_QueryShop">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${moreWebShopsRemain}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_QueryToOffer" sourceRef="Task_QueryShop" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoMoreShops" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreShopsToQuery" targetRef="Task_CompareOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompareToEnough" sourceRef="Task_CompareOffers" targetRef="Gateway_OneShopEnough"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OneShopCanSupply" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_OneShopEnough" targetRef="Task_ListPartsForOneShop">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${oneShopCanSupplyEnoughParts}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SeveralShops" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_OneShopEnough" targetRef="Task_ListPartsForSeveralShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OneShopListToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ListPartsForOneShop" targetRef="Gateway_MergeOrderLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SeveralShopsListToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ListPartsForSeveralShops" targetRef="Gateway_MergeOrderLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderListsToPlaceOrders" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeOrderLists" targetRef="Task_PlaceInitialOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrdersToFirstBatch" sourceRef="Task_PlaceInitialOrders" targetRef="Event_FirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstBatchToStartBuilding" sourceRef="Event_FirstBatch" targetRef="Task_StartBuilding"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartBuildingToBuild" sourceRef="Task_StartBuilding" targetRef="Task_Build"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildToStockZeroCheck" sourceRef="Task_Build" targetRef="Gateway_StockZero"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockZero" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_StockZero" targetRef="Task_EmailFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stockForSinglePartIsZero}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockNotZero" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_StockZero" targetRef="Gateway_StockBelowFive"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ComplaintToBelowFiveCheck" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Gateway_StockBelowFive"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockBelowFive" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_StockBelowFive" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stockForSinglePartBelow5}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockNotBelowFive" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_StockBelowFive" targetRef="End_ContinueBuilding"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheapestReorderToBatch" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Event_CheapestBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheapestBatchToUpdate" sourceRef="Event_CheapestBatch" targetRef="Task_UpdateStockAfterCheapestBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateCheapestToBelowThree" sourceRef="Task_UpdateStockAfterCheapestBatch" targetRef="Gateway_StockBelowThree"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockBelowThree" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_StockBelowThree" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stockForSinglePartBelow3}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockNotBelowThree" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_StockBelowThree" targetRef="End_ContinueBuilding"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FastestReorderToBatch" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Event_FastestBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FastestBatchToUpdate" sourceRef="Event_FastestBatch" targetRef="Task_UpdateStockAfterFastestBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateFastestToStockZeroCheck" sourceRef="Task_UpdateStockAfterFastestBatch" targetRef="Gateway_StockZero"/>

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_DeliveryTiming">
      <bpmn:text>Parts arrive in batches in random order, typically 2 days earlier or later than expected.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_FirstBatchTiming" sourceRef="Annotation_DeliveryTiming" targetRef="Event_FirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_CheapestBatchTiming" sourceRef="Annotation_DeliveryTiming" targetRef="Event_CheapestBatch"/>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_FastestBatchTiming" sourceRef="Annotation_DeliveryTiming" targetRef="Event_FastestBatch"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
